temperature_scale: not stated (printed as thermodynamic temperature T/K)
conversion_needs: atm to Pa if the atm columns are used (1 atm = 101325 Pa); GPa column needs none
title_as_printed: Henry's Constant H2,1(Psigma,1,T) for Ethane Dissolved in Water as a Function of the Thermodynamic Temperature T a

footnotes_as_printed.a: delta is the percent deviation from either smoothing eq 22 (CGW) or 23 (BK). Average percent deviation, eq 25: alpha_CGW = alpha_BK = +-0.078

value.what: Henry's constant H_2,1 = lim (f2/x2), fugacity over mole fraction of dissolved gas (mole-fraction basis), as defined in the paper's eq 1-2 (equation text not captured in detail), evaluated at the saturation (vapour) pressure of water at T, including Poynting correction

value2.what: same quantity in atm (1.01325e5 Pa per atm)

extra_unmapped: h21/atm (uncorrected Henry's constant at the experimental total pressure P)
phi_2 (fugacity coefficient of the gas in the vapour phase, calculated)
H21(P,T)/atm (Henry's constant at the experimental pressure P after fugacity correction)
delta BK, delta CGW (percent deviations from the authors' smoothing equations, calculated)
notes: Each row is one experiment (one filled apparatus run). Digit groups printed with a thin space (e.g. 23 099.2) are written without the space. Several rows are derived by the authors from the measured solubility (the apparatus measures gas amounts, pressure and volume); Henry's constants are the authors' direct reported result.
pressure_note: P = total equilibrium pressure at the experimental temperature (gas + water vapour), atm
